independent_evaluator.approval_scope: Freeze diagnosis_scope, fault_taxonomy, coverage_matrix, metric_policy and reasoning_rubric for G1.1 no-ground-truth technical testing and independent acceptance. This approval does not preselect gray-box/UDE over PINN, TFM or custom models; G3 promotion requires reproducible evidence under the same frozen protocol, split, resource budget and independent evaluator.
independent_evaluator.attestation_text_zh: 我同意按 G1.1 冻结协议继续无真值技术测试和独立验收。该审批仅冻结 diagnosis_scope、fault_taxonomy、coverage_matrix、metric_policy 和 reasoning_rubric，不预先认定灰盒/UDE优于PINN、TFM或自设计模型。G3模型晋级必须在相同冻结协议、数据切分、资源预算和独立评测器下，以可复现证据决定，并继续遵守不得删除或跳过测试、修改分母、合并不可辨识类别、扩大UNKNOWN或降低阈值的限制。
declarations: The reviewer did not participate in candidate model training, tuning or threshold selection.
The reviewer did not read formal hidden-acceptance truth.
The reviewer reviewed diagnosis_scope, fault_taxonomy, coverage_matrix, metric_policy and reasoning_rubric.
The approval does not preselect gray-box/UDE over PINN, TFM or custom models.
Tests may not be deleted or skipped; denominators may not be changed; non-identifiable classes may not be merged; UNKNOWN may not be expanded; thresholds may not be lowered to obtain PASS.
independence_declaration_zh: 我未参与当前候选的模型训练、调参和阈值选择。
我未读取正式 hidden-acceptance 真值。
